# Independent review: dyadic source preflight

Reviewed candidate SHA256:
`44e620868aa41f065310a1744fb10824af2d235024cf32620c4e42b35b0d591a`

## Verdict

**ACCEPT_SCOPED_DYADIC_SOURCE_IDENTITY_AND_ODD_BLOCK_ZERO_OBSTRUCTION_ONLY.**

D1 follows from the even/odd gamma-rate split and the duplication identity.
The density formula D3 has the correct factor and total mass, and the
uniform `[1/4,1]` size-biased representation D4 follows directly by
conditioning.  The all-complex Mellin identity D5, its removable value at
`p=-1`, and the zero lattice D6 are correct.

At the original xi centre the zero map in D7--D8 has imaginary part `1/2`.
The only real nuisance-zero tilt is `b=-1`, where the xi factor instead
samples `xi(i w)`.  Thus no real power tilt can satisfy both requirements.
This is a scoped obstruction to treating the odd block as a pre-existing
real-zero source; it supplies neither a theta V witness nor a general
source-rebuild impossibility or RH claim.
